The 2025–26 Kuwait Crown Prince Cup was the 32nd edition of the Kuwait Crown Prince Cup. Kuwait SC are the defending champions winning 2024–25 edition over Al-Arabi 1–0 after extra time. this edition sees two new teams participating Al-Shamiya FC and Sporty FC, making a total of 18 teams this edition.[1]
